summary: Programs by window and file. A new Qt-free module workbench/app_files.py: the five programs it knows (Firefox, GIMP, KiCad, Blender, Godot: their files, window classes and entry ids), and three Kernel operations in a 1.0 A1 block: appfile.open (execute: a file of Files opened in the app the owner chose, else its default from mimeapps.list, else the family's own existing bridge (programs.godot.open for a Godot project, programs.blender.open for a .blend) or an installed app of the family; started through S2's launch_app and S1's session_launch; a session row kept with the files watched and their digests, the processes and S3's window-list place), appfile.look (execute, called only on a change: the Kernel reads S3's window list itself (the window by its process, else by its program and the file's name in its title, else by its program's window that appeared or changed since the start, which covers a Firefox that hands the page to a running one), each watched file's bytes (a new digest recorded through L4's revisions.record, verified on disk), and the close; with no window list, the processes) and appfile.list (read, observer). mark_board (hooked in board_model.Desk after L4's): a FILE tile says OPENING IN <APP> / OPEN IN <APP> (with a window mark) / <APP> CLOSED (two hours), its first line "revision N, saved in <app>" or "since hh:mm, not saved yet"; L4's chain marks the admitted source of the earlier revision and what rests on it; A1 adds: what the owner linked to a file by their word (board.keep) before its newest revision is marked RECHECK and its wire "recheck" (and kept links to plain files are now drawn at all). workbench/app_files_qt.py: host.app_files watches open sessions (QFileSystemWatcher re-armed after rename-over saves, a 1.2 s glance at file sizes/times, S3's reading and the processes; the Kernel look runs off the window thread only when something differs), says each change as a line in her column (shell2 face, her fixed words registered with mind_words) and the status line, and redraws the board. Doors: the board's FILE tile right-click (Open in <app>, Open with..., Bring <app>'s window forward, KiCad checks / KiBot outputs for KiCad files, the Godot room for project.godot: the existing rooms), every apps_qt.open_app with one file of Files (Open with, default app anywhere), and L4's Full program (depths_qt). Smoke: nox 12/12, x graphite 39/39 (1920x1200 and 1366x768), kasandra 10/10, day 10/10 OK, with stand-in programs under Xvfb and S3's stand-in window manager.

decisions: Operation names appfile.* (not programs.*, which program_build already uses for its rooms, and in the Apps vocabulary).

Watching is done by the Kernel on request (appfile.look, execute) so the window list and the bytes are read by the system, not reported by the window; the window calls it only when its cheap glance sees a difference, so the journal gets one event per real change, never a poll. Each disagreement between the glance and the Kernel's record is asked about once, never in a loop.

The tile says the program in its STATE word (FILE - OPEN IN GIMP) so it shows on neighbour tiles too, with its own mark (a window: title bar filled while open, hollow while looked for) besides the word; closed shows for two hours after the close.

Godot and Blender go through their existing bridges (program_build) when the program is installed and the owner did not choose another app in Open with: Godot opens the editor on the project folder, Blender with --disable-autoexec (scripts in a .blend not run). An app chosen in Open with is always used as chosen.

KiCad: the project's .kicad_pro/.kicad_sch/.kicad_pcb of one name are watched together; Godot: project.godot and its scenes (at most 40). No file of these programs is parsed (GIMP .xcf, .blend, KiCad files).
Firefox is given a local file from Files only (never an address); its line says Graphite fetches nothing for it.

Dependants: L4's chain (the admitted source of the earlier revision and what rests on it) plus links the owner kept by their word to the file before its newest revision (marked RECHECK, the wire "recheck"); nothing is written into any record.
X window ids are reused by later programs: a session found by its process keeps its window only while that window's pid is still one of its processes.
Opening the same file again sets the earlier session aside ("opened again"); its window, if any, stays the owner's.
Her lines go into her column's exchange without switching the column's page (no focus taken), and into the status line.

The seed's catalog will need the three appfile.* operations when it is rebuilt.

K9 (her hand in other programs): appfile.list gives the session of a file (program, process ids, window id, title); a window she should act in is one Graphite opened for that file. K2: appfile.open is not a registry tool yet (its number and check are K2's to give); its verify would be appfile.look's window event, as AppOpen does.
L2: Desk._kept drops a kept link whose end is a plain file not yet on the desk at __init__; A1's mark_board now adds those edges (both ends brought onto the desk).
L4: depths.mark_board marks only what rests directly on the admitted source; a calculation two steps away (on the sheet) stays CURRENT on the board (seen in the frames).
S3's strip names the GIMP stand-in window "GNU Image Manipulation P..." (the entry's Name), while A1 says "GIMP" (the family's short name).

A dialog appearing in the program (e.g. "Save changes?") is not said by A1 (K7/K9's).

release_note: Files open in other programs: from a file's tile on the board (or Open with, or Full program), Graphite opens it in its program (Firefox, GIMP, KiCad, Blender, Godot, or any installed app), finds the program's window and names it on the tile ("open in GIMP"), records each save as a new revision verified on disk, marks what rests on it for a recheck, says so in Kasandra's column, and says when the window closes. Godot and Blender open through their existing bridges; KiCad's project files are watched together.
